entities.summary: Dyshawn Dylan Pierre is a Canadian professional basketball player for UNICS of the VTB United League. He is from Whitby, Ontario and played college basketball for the Dayton Flyers. Standing at 6 ft 6 in (1.98 m), he plays at the power forward and small forward positions.
